title: fix(components): an editable list's lookup column is wide enough for its record picker
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34601
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
File surface amended: ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-lookup-picker-floor-34601.test.tsx, ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts (doc comment only) — per claim 6940933031 (item 2, branch `claude/issue-34601-lookup-column-width`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表开启「行内编辑」后，查找类列（产品、负责人这类引用字段）的宽度不再小于 168px，和行项目表格（GridField）里查找列的最小宽度一致；只读列表、作者写死的列宽、用户手动拖的列宽都不变。
- 为什么改：实测查明 Product 列偏窄的来源：行内编辑列表的表格按单元格里显示的短名称自动定宽（如 "Consulting Hour" 只给 121px），而这列的编辑器是查找选择器，触发框只剩约 50px，下拉选项被截成「C..」「W.」。
- 风险与回滚：只改了表格自动列宽的一处下限，仅在「表格可编辑、该列是引用字段、该列可编辑」三者同时成立时生效；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` 里 `autoSizedWidths` 的 `pickerFloor`；其次是新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：打开 Showcase 的 Invoice Lines 列表，把窗口调到约 820px 宽，在 Display 里打开 Edit inline，点 Product 单元格：该列应为 168px 宽（修复前 121px）；关闭行内编辑后该列回到 121px。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `data-table` sizes a column with no explicit `width` from what its cells draw, with an 80px floor. In an editable table, a foreign-key column (the `foreignKey` flag `ObjectGrid` already stamps on lookup, master-detail, tree and user columns) opens the record picker as its cell editor. Sized from the short names it draws, the picker's trigger got a few dozen pixels.
- Now, when the table is `editable`, the column carries `foreignKey: true` and the column itself is not `editable: false`, the auto-sized width is floored at 168px, the width `GridField` gives its lookup columns (`MIN_WIDTH_BY_TYPE.lookup`). The value is a private constant in `data-table.tsx`: `@object-ui/components` cannot import `@object-ui/fields`, and adding a public export for it would widen a published surface.
- Only the estimate is floored. An explicit `width` (the view's pin, or the user's persisted resize) is drawn as written, so the seat's ruling that a pinned width stays exact holds here too. `GridField` is not touched.
- The `TableColumn.foreignKey` doc comment in `@object-ui/types` now says what an editable table does with the flag.
- Patch changeset for `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/types`.

## Live measurement (item 2: where the narrow lookup column comes from)

Showcase app, own backend (`objectstack dev --fresh`) plus the Console Vite dev server from this tree, Chromium. hotcrm `ddcd6e60` (read-only clone): `crm_quote_line_item` declares no `inlineEdit`, so quote lines are a related-list card on the quote page (a read-only `data-table`, no picker). The record picker in a line table is reached two ways, and both were measured:

1. **Inline line-item grid in the record form** (`GridField`, DOM `div[data-testid=line-items] > table`), showcase Invoice "Edit", Product column: unpinned, style `width: 168px`, laid out 205px at 1280 and 209px at 375. Not the source.
2. **A list with "Edit inline" on** (`data-table`, DOM `div[data-testid=console-route] > div[data-testid=record-list-host] > div[data-table-scroll-box] > table`, column `data-auto-width-key="product"`), showcase Invoice Lines, Product column. This is the source:

| viewport | column before | picker trigger before | popover before | column after | picker trigger after | popover after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 | 121 (stretched to 185) | 115 | 115 | 168 (stretched to 219) | 149 | 149 |
| 1024 | 121 (laid out 145) | 75 | 75 | 168 (laid out 171) | 101 | 101 |
| 820 | 121 | 51 | 51 ("C..", "W.") | 168 | 98 | 98 |
| 375 | phone card list, no table | n/a | n/a | unchanged | n/a | n/a |

- Control: the same list with inline edit off keeps the Product column at 121px after the fix.
- "Popover after" is the trigger width because item 1 (objectstack#34658, the picker's own 18rem floor) is not on `main`. With #34658's `LookupField.tsx` change applied locally on top of this branch (not committed, restored to HEAD afterwards, `git diff HEAD` empty), the popover read 288px at 1024 (right edge 872) and 288px at 820 (right edge 820, inside the viewport). Both items together meet the card's acceptance; this PR alone fixes the column.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-lookup-picker-floor-34601.test.tsx` (data-table has no shared harness file; each card has its own): an editable foreign-key column drawing "Widget A" is 168px, not 112px. Controls: read-only table, no `foreignKey` flag, and a column with `editable: false` all stay 112px. A wide name (320px) and an explicit `width: 90` are left as they are. happy-dom has no layout, so this is the arithmetic path. The pixels are the live reading above.
- Ablation, on the committed head through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the test imports `../data-table` and `@object-ui/types` resolves to source through the vitest alias, so there is no dist leg): replacing the floor expression with `(width)` turned the first test red (`expected '112px' to be '168px'`, 1 failed / 2 passed), and the file was restored to the HEAD blob `f19704007c07` with `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Grouped lists compute their own explicit column widths with the same 80px floor (`groupedColumnWidths` in `ObjectGrid.tsx`), so an editable grouped list keeps a narrow lookup column. That file belongs to another in-flight card in this container and is outside this PR's surface. Not measured live.
- A trigger in a 168px column is about 98px, because the picker's browse-all button takes about 40px of the cell. Names longer than that still read in full only in the open list (item 1).

## Verification

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/ packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table.dateOnlyZone-10183.test.tsx`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 38 passed, 1 skipped (39), Tests 248 passed, 7 skipped (255).
- Dependency closure `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/types run type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0. The new test file is in components' `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly` count 1).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 38 commands, every one exit 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (5077 passed, 2 skipped) and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first returned exit 3 (queue-timeout on the shared lock, NOT MEASURED) and was re-run under the lock with its kept slot: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero, all 38 with exit codes).
- `pnpm check:changeset-fixed`: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
